summary.name: agents.inc
summary.one_liner: agents.inc is a vendor offering autonomous AI agents for enterprise marketing, sales and market intelligence, delivered as an Agents-as-a-Service engagement.
use_cases: Generating weekly retail leaflets and product brochures from product data
Qualifying inbound leads across web chat, email and WhatsApp
Researching target accounts and producing decision-maker reports and decks
Monitoring news, filings and social for brand and competitor changes
Scouting and analysing emerging companies for innovation pipelines
summary.what_it_does: The page describes autonomous agents that research markets, produce marketing campaigns and talk to customers, grounded in the client's own data. Named use cases include campaign management (copy, layout and editable .idml files), brand monitoring, market intelligence across ten sectors, lead qualification with calendar booking and CRM write-back, account research with decision-maker reports and decks, and innovation scouting. Agents are wired into systems of record such as SAP, Salesforce, a DAM and calendars. The vendor says each factual claim is cross-referenced against source before output ships, with an audit trail. Deployment is described as either as a service on their infrastructure or inside the client's own estate.
notable: Agents-as-a-Service model with a base fee plus per-task pricing
Grounding and source cross-checking before output ships, with audit trail
Four-week path from scoping to autonomous production, per the page
Listed on the Everest Group Agentic AI Matrix (2026), per the page
caveats: Pricing requires a scoping session and custom cost model; no public prices are listed
Page claims (zero error rate, 70-80% failure rates, customer results) are vendor-stated and not independently verified
Aimed at enterprise clients; the page names large customers such as AXA, E.ON and Petrobras
